summary: John's 9th-great-grandmother, wife of Job Smith and daughter of John Thompson of Setauket.
bio:
Daughter of John Thompson of Setauket. Round 1 rated her parentage 'probable to confirmed'. The tree and older sources (Thompson 1918; F. K. Smith 1967) name her mother as Hannah Brewster; Round 3 (Jacobus, TAG 12:199–204, 13:221) showed John Thompson's only recorded wife was Mary, and that the Hannah Brewster in this family married John's son Samuel. Preferred mother: Mary (surname unknown). Dates from tree 1657–1718; PDF gives the couple c.1647–c.1719.

Pelletreau's Appendix states that Job Smith 'married Elizabeth, daughter of John Thompson, Esq., of Setauket' and lists her seven children ([R4-S1]). Weygant (1897) repeats this but adds the now-disproven Mayflower Brewster mother and Rev. William Thompson grandfather ([R4-S2]).
sources: Thompson, History of Long Island (1918 ed.) vol. 3 p. 295, https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
